affected_subject.reason: The public injectAndCall function of the router and its ETH/ERC20 balances are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Anyone can directly call injectAndCall, including setting target to an attacker EOA or attacker contract.

direct_effect.reason: Injected callerBalance is sent or approved to target, draining router-held ETH/ERC20 without authorization.

safety_relation_basis.reason: The missing onlyDelegatecall restriction and claim of unauthorized draining imply an expected access-control/state guarantee is violated.

summary: Fragments identify the public injectAndCall function, its unrestricted trigger, the transfer/approval effect draining router ETH/ERC20 balances, and an authorization relation showing the intended delegatecall restriction is absent.
